args.title: Fix parseStatement to ignore blank last line in input
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Modify parseStatement to more robustly handle blank lines at the end of input by ignoring final empty lines, preventing a 'Malformed row' error on files that end with a blank line.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

This issue is caused by the parser throwing a 'Malformed row' error on blank trailing lines in CSV input files. The responsible code is in src/ingest/parser.ts in the parseStatement function, which does not tolerate an empty last line. The fix is to improve the handling of trailing blank lines in the input, skipping them so they do not cause a malformed row error. A draft pull request has been opened to address this.
